summary.result: There are several problems of RDI in practical use, which include; the uncertainty of crop-water relations, the proper growth stages and water deficit degree of RDI applied, and the requirements of RDI to irrigation system and irrigation techniques.
summary.background: Regulated Deficit Irrigation (RDI) is one of the most important measures for the water-saving and high yield of crops.
summary.method: The theories of RDI were analyzed using the experiment data in Shaanxi and Gansu Province.
